scenario: contains is exact set membership over the sliding window (LSER.16.7.1): once an "error" tag has been absorbed, `contains(e.tag, "error")` is true. Pin: a rule gated `contains(e.tag, "error")` fires (action_log) after the error tag arrives; the lookup value threads through query_with_value to the SeriesBackendRingBuffer raw samples.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    tag: String mutable

series Event.tag:
    contains sliding 5_s

rule check:
    Event e where contains(e.tag, "error")
->
    log info "saw error"
